memory.description: Short facts recalled by the character in every conversation that uses this persona.
memory.empty: No memories yet. Use “Memorize” on a message, or add a fact below.
memory.addPlaceholder: New fact, e.g. The player is called Tom
memory.memorizeHint: Sum the fact up in one short sentence: it will be recalled in every conversation with this persona.
memory.extractExisting: Already known facts (do not repeat them):
memory.extractPrompt: You help keep a character's memory notebook. From the conversation below, suggest 3 to 5 new, lasting facts worth remembering for future conversations (names, relationships, items, key events, preferences). One fact per line, starting with “- ”, in the present tense, under 120 characters, in the language of the conversation. Do not repeat already known facts. Reply with the list only, no commentary.
